purpose: Name the runtime cursor for the HUD interaction-frame sequence.

contract.advance: The renderer reads one frame word and stores the post-read cursor after each interaction/HUD record.
contract.wrap: When the read word is zero at 0x000029DE, the cursor resets to 0x000029A8.

evidence: Existing HUD_INTERACTION_FRAME_SEQUENCE extent and consumer contract
conclusion: FF7DA8 is the per-runtime cursor into the HUD interaction frame table.
